name: GOOD LUCK BABY!
source:
Having a stroke of bad luck [i]sucks[/i]. Having a few [i]weeks[/i] of bad luck is even worse. That's something Hifumi Tanaka unfortunately learns first-hand. Stubbing her toe one too many times, losing her wallet on the train to the city, getting to school two hours late... this unrelenting streak of misfortune makes her cry out in frustration to the universe. “Can't something [i]good[/i] happen for once?!”

Hifumi's luck begins to turn around upon meeting the famous delinquent Kasumi Itou. Even though she's known at school for being trouble, the reality is that Kasumi is a funny, level-headed girl with a heart of gold. Just as their mutual crushes on each other begin to bloom, they are met with one heck of a surprise...

[b]A baby with a halo sitting happily on Kasumi's doorstep![/b]

Meeting this baby changes not [i]just[/i] the lives and luck of our girls, but the entire world  - and [i]maybe[/i] even the galaxy - as we know it. Can they evade the looming shadow of a mysterious villain known only as "Empress Metis" long enough to get this baby back home?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
运气不好[i]糟透了[/i]。有几个[i]周[/i]运气不好就更糟糕了。不幸的是，这是田中一富亲身经历的事情。多次撞到脚趾、在进城的火车上丢了钱包、迟到两个小时……这一系列的不幸让她向宇宙发出挫败的呼喊。“不能有什么[i]好的[/i]就发生一次吗？！”

在遇到了著名的不良少年伊藤霞后，一富美的运气开始好转。尽管霞在学校里出了名的麻烦，但事实上，霞是一个有趣、头脑冷静、有着一颗金子般的心的女孩。就在他们对彼此的好感开始绽放时，却迎来了一场意外……[b]一个带着光环的婴儿幸福地坐在霞的家门口！[/b]遇见这个宝贝并没有改变[i]只是[/i]我们女孩的生活和运气，还有整个世界 - 以及[i]或许[/i]甚至我们所知的银河系。他们能否躲开一个神秘恶棍的阴影，并把这个婴儿带回家？

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel/description]众筹[/url]]
